description: Preview & edit Markdown, Excel, CSV, JSONL, Word, PDF, PowerPoint, EPUB, Archives (ZIP/TAR/VSIX/WHL) and Images inside VS Code — with live formulas, annotations, CV BBox/YOLO/COCO tools, Image Diff and Markdown conversion.
command.showPreviewToSide: DocsView: Open Preview to the Side
config.markdown.scrollSync: Synchronize scrolling between the Markdown editor and its preview.
config.markdown.contentWidth: Content width of the Markdown preview: centered fixed reading width or adaptive full-pane width.
config.markdown.splitPosition: Which side the source editor and preview appear on when opening side-by-side split view.
config.csv.delimiter: Delimiter used for CSV files. "auto" detects it from the file content.
config.appearance.theme: Preview theme for Markdown and EPUB views. "editor" uses the colours of the current VS Code theme.
config.appearance.colorScheme: Light or dark appearance of DocsView editors. "auto" follows the VS Code theme.
config.appearance.invertPages: In a dark appearance, show PDF and Word pages with inverted colours.
config.language: Language of the DocsView interface. "auto" follows the VS Code display language.
config.highlightRowColumn: Highlight the row and column of the selected cell in CSV, Excel and JSONL views, and of the hovered cell in Markdown tables.
config.table.lockEditing: Lock cell editing in CSV, Excel and JSONL views until it is unlocked from the toolbar.
config.showNotices: Show informational format notice banners at the top of previews.
config.image.loupePosition: Placement of the pixel magnifier loupe in image previews: follow the mouse cursor or stay at a fixed corner.
config.sidebarPosition: Which side of the preview the navigation / outline sidebar appears on.
config.toolbar: Items shown on the left and right sides of the DocsView top toolbar, and their display order.
config.comments.author: Author name recorded when adding comments to Word, PowerPoint or PDF files (leave blank to use your system username).
command.getViewerState: DocsView: Get Active Viewer State Snapshot
config.ai.provider: Language model provider used by DocsView AI Assistant (VS Code built-in/Copilot models, local gateways, or OpenAI-compatible APIs).
config.ai.provider.0: Models provided by Visual Studio Code (e.g. GitHub Copilot Chat) — no API key required.
config.ai.provider.4: Qwen / Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API.
config.ai.baseUrl: Custom OpenAI-compatible API base URL (leave blank to use the selected provider's default).
config.ai.model: Model ID to use for DocsView AI Assistant (leave blank to auto-discover or use the provider's default).
